source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The mbox parser treats input smaller than MinChunk as EOF. The accepted PumpData repeatedly reads until MinChunk or a real zero-byte read, then feeds the parser. A short underlying read is not itself EOF. Any caller or buffering refactor must preserve that contract. Only the listed current loop and historical parser change were read, not a new short-read runtime experiment.
title: Preserve the parser minimum-chunk contract across short reads
